blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Enhanced Closure Testing Method (增強膠塞測試方法): TR85 的核心貢獻。這不是全新的發明，而是將既有的萃取、攪拌、計數技術加以「標準化」，讓不同實驗室、不同公司能用同一把尺來衡量膠塞上的可見微粒負擔。
blocks.en: Enhanced Closure Testing Method: The core contribution of TR85. This is not a brand-new invention; it "standardizes" existing extraction, agitation, and counting techniques so that different laboratories and companies can measure the visible particle burden on closures with the same yardstick.

blocks.zh: Size Thresholds (粒徑閾值): 微粒 ≥ 100 μm、纖維 ≥ 300 μm。這些數字不是隨意設定，而是與空瓶檢測研究中的 PoD (Probability of Detection, 檢測機率) 數據相互驗證得出的。
blocks.en: Size Thresholds: particles ≥ 100 μm, fibers ≥ 300 μm. These numbers were not set arbitrarily; they were cross-validated against the PoD (Probability of Detection) data from the empty container inspection study.

blocks.zh: Probability of Detection, PoD (檢測機率): 在特定檢測條件下成功發現某尺寸微粒的機率。本報告中空瓶研究達到 125 μm 微粒和 300 μm 纖維平均 70% PoD，這為閾值設定提供了科學依據。
blocks.en: Probability of Detection, PoD: The probability of successfully finding a particle of a given size under specific inspection conditions. In this report, the empty container study achieved an average PoD of 70% for 125 μm particles and 300 μm fibers, which provides a scientific basis for the threshold setting.

blocks.zh: Apparent Visible Area (表觀可見面積): 將微粒和纖維的 PoD 統一到同一維度的關鍵概念。不同形狀的污染物（顆粒 vs 纖維）可以透過投影面積來比較檢測難易度。
blocks.en: Apparent Visible Area: The key concept that brings the PoD of particles and fibers onto the same dimension. Contaminants of different shapes (particles vs. fibers) can be compared for ease of detection through their projected area.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家連鎖餐廳，每家分店都需要檢查餐具是否乾淨。過去每家店用自己的標準 -- 有的用目視、有的用放大鏡、搖晃水杯的力道也不同。TR85 的做法就像制定一份統一的「餐具清潔度檢測 SOP」：規定用多少水、搖多久、多大的殘留物算不合格。這樣總部才能真正比較各分店的清潔水準，也才能跟餐具供應商談出有意義的品質規格。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a restaurant chain in which every branch must check that its tableware is clean. In the past each branch used its own standard: some by eye, some with a magnifier, and each shook the glasses with a different force. TR85's approach is like drawing up one unified "tableware cleanliness testing SOP": it specifies how much water to use, how long to shake, and how large a residue counts as a failure. Only then can headquarters truly compare the cleanliness of each branch, and negotiate meaningful quality specifications with the tableware supplier.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 標準化的價值不僅在技術，更在商業： 當膠塞製造商與藥廠使用相同的測試方法和閾值時，雙方能基於共同語言來制定規格、評估偏差、比較供應商。這直接降低了供應鏈中的溝通成本和爭議風險。
blocks.en: The value of standardization is commercial as well as technical: When closure manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies use the same test method and thresholds, both sides can set specifications, evaluate deviations, and compare suppliers in a common language. This directly reduces communication costs and the risk of disputes in the supply chain.

blocks.zh: 空瓶 vs 充填後容器檢測效能相似： 這是一項重要發現。它意味著藥廠可以在充填之前（空瓶階段）就進行有效的目視檢測，提早攔截不合格容器，減少充填後的損失。這對高價值生物製劑尤其有經濟意義。
blocks.en: Inspection performance is similar for empty and filled containers: This is an important finding. It means a pharmaceutical company can carry out effective visual inspection before filling (at the empty container stage), intercepting nonconforming containers early and reducing losses after filling. This is especially significant economically for high-value biologics.

blocks.zh: 風險為本 (Risk-based) 的限度設定： 報告明確指出理想目標是「practical working standard which incorporates risk-based limits」。這與 ICH Q9 品質風險管理精神一致 -- 不是一刀切的零容忍，而是依產品特性和臨床風險設定合理的可見微粒允收限度。
blocks.en: Risk-based limit setting: The report states clearly that the ideal goal is a "practical working standard which incorporates risk-based limits". This is consistent with the spirit of ICH Q9 quality risk management: not a one-size-fits-all zero tolerance, but reasonable acceptance limits for visible particles set according to product characteristics and clinical risk.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景： 假設你是一家 CDMO 的品保經理，客戶抱怨注射劑成品中偶爾發現可見微粒。你可以引用 TR85 的標準化方法來：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Suppose you are a QA manager at a CDMO and a client complains that visible particles are occasionally found in the finished injectable product. You can cite the standardized method in TR85 to:

blocks.zh: 上游管控： 要求膠塞供應商按 Enhanced Closure Testing Method 提供每批膠塞的可見微粒數據，建立進料規格
blocks.en: Upstream control: Require closure suppliers to provide visible particle data for each lot of closures according to the Enhanced Closure Testing Method, and establish incoming material specifications

blocks.zh: 進料檢測： 在空瓶階段就執行標準化目視檢測（本報告證實空瓶檢測與充填後效能相似），提早篩除不合格容器
blocks.en: Incoming inspection: Perform standardized visual inspection at the empty container stage (this report confirms that empty container inspection performs similarly to inspection after filling) to screen out nonconforming containers early

blocks.zh: 數據驅動決策： 使用 PoD 和 apparent visible area 的概念，將你的檢測能力量化，向客戶展示你的品質管控水準
blocks.en: Data-driven decisions: Use the concepts of PoD and apparent visible area to quantify your inspection capability and demonstrate your quality control level to clients

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: TR85 設定微粒閾值為 100 μm、纖維閾值為 300 μm。為什麼纖維的閾值比微粒大三倍？試從「apparent visible area」的角度思考。
blocks.en: TR85 sets the particle threshold at 100 μm and the fiber threshold at 300 μm. Why is the fiber threshold three times larger than the particle threshold? Think about it from the standpoint of "apparent visible area".

blocks.zh: 如果你要說服公司投資空瓶檢測系統，你會如何用 TR85 的空瓶研究數據來建立商業論證？
blocks.en: If you wanted to persuade your company to invest in an empty container inspection system, how would you use the empty container study data in TR85 to build the business case?

blocks.zh: 「risk-based limits suitable for the intended application」意味著不同產品可能有不同的可見微粒限度。請舉例說明一個高風險應用和一個較低風險應用，並說明為何限度應該不同。
blocks.en: "Risk-based limits suitable for the intended application" means different products may have different visible particle limits. Give an example of a high-risk application and a lower-risk application, and explain why the limits should differ.

blocks.zh: 7.0 References 參考文獻
blocks.en: 7.0 References

blocks.zh: 文獻框架總覽： TR85 的 33 篇參考文獻可分為以下幾類，幫助你建立延伸閱讀的地圖：
blocks.en: Overview of the reference framework: The 33 references in TR85 fall into the following categories, which help you build a map for further reading:

blocks.zh: 藥典標準 (Refs 1, 6, 23, 25-28): USP <790>、<788>、<1790>、Ph. Eur. 2.9.19/2.9.20、JP 6.06/6.07 -- 這些是全球三大藥典對注射劑微粒的核心章節
blocks.en: Pharmacopeial standards (Refs 1, 6, 23, 25-28): USP <790>, <788>, <1790>, Ph. Eur. 2.9.19/2.9.20, JP 6.06/6.07 -- the core chapters on particulate matter in injections in the three major pharmacopeias worldwide

blocks.zh: 法規要求 (Refs 20-21): 21 CFR 210/211 -- 美國 GMP 的法律基礎
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements (Refs 20-21): 21 CFR 210/211 -- the legal basis of US GMP

blocks.zh: ISO 標準 (Refs 24, 32): ISO 8871-3（膠塞釋出微粒）和 ISO 3696（分析用水）-- 測試方法的底層規範
blocks.en: ISO standards (Refs 24, 32): ISO 8871-3 (particles released from elastomeric closures) and ISO 3696 (water for analytical use) -- the underlying specifications for the test methods

blocks.zh: 臨床風險文獻 (Refs 8-19): 微粒對患者的臨床傷害證據，包括注射部位反應、血管栓塞、器官功能損傷、免疫反應等
blocks.en: Clinical risk literature (Refs 8-19): Evidence of clinical harm to patients from particles, including injection site reactions, vascular embolism, organ function damage, and immune responses

blocks.zh: PDA 產業文獻 (Refs 2-4, 22, 31): 行業最佳實踐，包括檢測驗證方法、微粒來源追蹤、行業調查數據
blocks.en: PDA industry literature (Refs 2-4, 22, 31): Industry best practices, including inspection validation methods, particle source tracing, and industry survey data

blocks.zh: 統計方法 (Refs 29-30, 33): 檢測程序評估方法學和特徵選擇統計工具（Boruta Package）
blocks.en: Statistical methods (Refs 29-30, 33): Methodology for evaluating inspection procedures and a statistical tool for feature selection (the Boruta Package)

blocks.zh: 這份參考文獻清單就像一份「菜譜的食材來源表」。一道好菜（TR85 的結論與方法）需要多種食材：藥典標準是「主食材」（米、麵），法規要求是「調味料」（鹽、糖），臨床文獻是「營養標示」（告訴你為什麼這些成分重要），而統計方法是「烹飪器具」（幫你精準控制火候）。讀懂這份清單，你就知道每個結論背後站著哪些證據支柱。
blocks.en: This reference list is like a "table of ingredient sources for a recipe". A good dish (TR85's conclusions and methods) needs many ingredients: the pharmacopeial standards are the "staple ingredients" (rice, flour), the regulatory requirements are the "seasonings" (salt, sugar), the clinical literature is the "nutrition label" (telling you why these ingredients matter), and the statistical methods are the "cooking utensils" (helping you control the heat precisely). Once you understand this list, you know which pillars of evidence stand behind each conclusion.

blocks.zh: 三大藥典的微粒章節對照：
blocks.en: Comparison of the particulate matter chapters in the three major pharmacopeias:

blocks.zh: USP: <788> 次可見微粒（定量）、<790> 可見微粒（定性）、<1790> 檢測方法指引
blocks.en: USP: <788> subvisible particles (quantitative), <790> visible particles (qualitative), <1790> guidance on inspection methods

blocks.zh: Ph. Eur.: 2.9.19 次可見微粒、2.9.20 可見微粒
blocks.en: Ph. Eur.: 2.9.19 subvisible particles, 2.9.20 visible particles

blocks.zh: JP: 6.07 不溶性微粒、6.06 異物不溶性微粒
blocks.en: JP: 6.07 insoluble particulate matter, 6.06 foreign insoluble matter

blocks.zh: 這三大藥典對微粒的定義和測試方法大致協調，但在具體限度和方法細節上仍有差異。CDMO 若服務全球市場，需同時滿足最嚴格的要求。
blocks.en: The three pharmacopeias are broadly harmonized in their definitions and test methods for particles, but still differ in specific limits and method details. A CDMO serving the global market needs to meet the strictest requirements at the same time.

blocks.zh: Ref 5 的特殊意義： Shabushnig 從 FDA 召回數據庫中提取的數據，直接說明了可見微粒問題在現實中的監管後果 -- 產品召回。這不只是學術討論，而是有實際商業和患者安全影響的問題。
blocks.en: The special significance of Ref 5: Data extracted by Shabushnig from the FDA recall database directly illustrates the real-world regulatory consequence of the visible particle problem: product recalls. This is not merely an academic discussion; it is an issue with real commercial and patient safety impact.

blocks.zh: 如何利用這份參考文獻清單：
blocks.en: How to use this reference list:

blocks.zh: 建立內部培訓教材時： Refs 7-9（Langille、Bukofzer、Ayres）是解釋「為什麼微粒管控重要」的最佳入門文獻
blocks.en: When building internal training materials: Refs 7-9 (Langille, Bukofzer, Ayres) are the best introductory literature for explaining why particle control matters

blocks.zh: 撰寫驗證方案時： Refs 29-30（Knapp & Kushner）提供了檢測程序驗證的經典方法學
blocks.en: When writing validation protocols: Refs 29-30 (Knapp & Kushner) provide classic methodology for validating inspection procedures

blocks.zh: 與供應商談規格時： Ref 24（ISO 8871-3）是膠塞微粒釋出測試的國際標準，也是與膠塞供應商溝通的共同語言
blocks.en: When discussing specifications with suppliers: Ref 24 (ISO 8871-3) is the international standard for particle release testing of closures, and a common language for communicating with closure suppliers

blocks.zh: 回應法規查核時： Refs 20-21（21 CFR 210/211）加上相關藥典章節，構成你的合規依據
blocks.en: When responding to regulatory inspections: Refs 20-21 (21 CFR 210/211), together with the relevant pharmacopeial chapters, form the basis of your compliance

blocks.zh: TR85 引用了大量臨床傷害文獻（Refs 10-19）。這些文獻在技術報告中扮演什麼角色？為什麼一份關於「測試方法」的報告需要引用臨床數據？
blocks.en: TR85 cites a large body of clinical harm literature (Refs 10-19). What role does this literature play in a technical report? Why does a report about "test methods" need to cite clinical data?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 同時服務美國、歐洲和日本市場，你需要同時參考哪些藥典章節？請從參考文獻中找出對應的條目。
blocks.en: If your CDMO serves the US, European, and Japanese markets at the same time, which pharmacopeial chapters do you need to refer to? Find the corresponding entries in the reference list.

blocks.zh: Ref 33（Boruta Package）是一個統計特徵選擇工具。想想看，在微粒檢測數據分析中，可能需要從哪些變數中選擇關鍵特徵？
blocks.en: Ref 33 (the Boruta Package) is a statistical feature selection tool. Think about which variables in particle inspection data analysis might require selection of key features.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 標準化是核心貢獻： TR85 的 Enhanced Closure Testing Method 統一了萃取、攪拌和粒徑閾值（微粒 ≥ 100 μm、纖維 ≥ 300 μm），讓膠塞可見微粒評估有了共同語言
blocks.en: Standardization is the core contribution: TR85's Enhanced Closure Testing Method unifies extraction, agitation, and particle size thresholds (particles ≥ 100 μm, fibers ≥ 300 μm), giving the assessment of visible particles on closures a common language

blocks.zh: 空瓶檢測獲得科學驗證： 研究證實空瓶與充填後容器的目視檢測效能相似（125 μm 微粒和 300 μm 纖維達 70% PoD），支持在充填前進行有效攔截
blocks.en: Empty container inspection is scientifically validated: The study confirmed that visual inspection performance is similar for empty and filled containers (70% PoD for 125 μm particles and 300 μm fibers), supporting effective interception before filling

blocks.zh: Apparent Visible Area 統一不同形態污染物： 透過表觀可見面積，可以將微粒和纖維的 PoD 統一比較，為建立跨形態的允收標準提供科學基礎
blocks.en: Apparent visible area unifies contaminants of different forms: Through apparent visible area, the PoD of particles and fibers can be compared on one basis, providing a scientific foundation for acceptance criteria across forms

blocks.zh: 風險為本的限度設定： 報告倡導依產品臨床風險和預期用途設定合理的可見微粒限度，而非一刀切的零容忍
blocks.en: Risk-based limit setting: The report advocates setting reasonable visible particle limits according to the clinical risk and intended use of the product, rather than a one-size-fits-all zero tolerance

blocks.zh: 文獻地圖涵蓋完整： 33 篇參考文獻橫跨三大藥典、美國 GMP 法規、ISO 標準、臨床風險證據和統計方法學，為進一步研究提供完整路徑
blocks.en: The reference map is comprehensive: The 33 references span the three major pharmacopeias, US GMP regulations, ISO standards, clinical risk evidence, and statistical methodology, giving a complete path for further study
